verdicts.observation: Timeline with three cavemen and 'Your ancestor' label shifts and enlarges between prev and burst, then pans right to leave one caveman enlarged.
Same timeline scene zooms/pans fast, label and left caveman slide off-frame while the center caveman grows.
Center caveman is enlarged and moves across the frame as the camera zooms in; the neighbor is pushed out at the edge.
Caveman face zooms to fill the frame and settles; 'no name' text appears only in the +8 frame.
Caveman and 'no name' text stay the same but drop/shift slightly down between frames, then the view pans down to the legs.
Camera pans down from the face to torso and then to feet while 'no name' text stays beside it.
Continuing downward pan from torso to bare feet; text still reads 'no name' until the +8 frame says 'no shoes'.
Feet image is the same in all frames; the text changes from 'no name' (prev) to 'no shoes' (burst onward).
Feet and 'no shoes' look nearly identical in prev and burst; only a slight upward shift starts by the +3 frame, so the cause is ambiguous from 4 frames.
Feet view begins panning upward toward the torso and face, with 'no shoes' text unchanged.
Camera continues to pan up the caveman from legs to face; the text still reads 'no shoes'.
Pan up continues to the face; the text swaps to bold 'no idea' only in the +8 frame.
Caveman remains the same while the text changes from 'no shoes' (prev) to bold 'no idea' (burst onward).
A new couch-sitting character with phone, drink and snack bags slides in from the right edge while the caveman is still at left.
The couch character continues sliding in from the right, bigger in the burst frame than in prev, and the caveman shrinks to a full figure.
Couch character is mostly in; the caveman has shrunk to a full figure with feet visible.
Caveman and couch character both appear to shrink and shift left slightly across frames, suggesting a camera zoom-out or settling.
Two-character composition keeps the same layout but slightly rescales and shifts between frames.
View zooms in on the couch character as the caveman slides off left; by +8 the background goes grey and then dark with a distorted, bloodshot-eyed close-up.
A card reading 'but here is the thing' is replaced by a wide timeline of many small cavemen on a white background.
The '5. Ice Age' title card is replaced by a plain globe drawing, with the text gone in the burst frame.
Globe grows larger over the frames while a '20,000 years a...' text slides off the right side.
The globe is covered in white ice, and the ice cap gradually recedes at the top, revealing continents, as a graphic animation.
A mammoth enters from the right, with only tusks visible in prev, while the caveman with height label shrinks to make room.
The mammoth slides further into the frame from the right while the caveman figure keeps shrinking.
The mammoth continues moving in and fills out more of the right side while the caveman shrinks; likely a zoom-out.
The whole mammoth is now visible; the caveman has become small with the height bar and a stray tick mark appears at left.
The projected picture of a group around a fire on the classroom chalkboard fades out and squashes, replaced by a dim texture of stone tools.
The projected fire-group picture fades out to a blank board and then a stone-tool image appears.
A faint stone-tool image grows and brightens on the board, partly through a dissolve.
The stone-tool image dims and fades to a blank board and then a cave painting appears.
The stone-tool image fades out and a cave painting of animals fades in on the board.
A faint cave painting grows and brightens on the board as a fade in.
The cave painting fades out to blank board and a new cave image with horses appears.
The painting dims, a stone-tool image flickers briefly, then a new horses cave image appears.
Two cavemen in a field have small pose and head changes (the bald one's gaze and the bearded one's brow) while the background is constant.
The same field scene has minor head and face changes in both characters and a slight body sway.
A dead tree on a soil mound pans left to show another tree entering from the right, and the small leaf vanishes by +8; bugs also appear.
The scene with a tree and soil mounds slides sideways with small insects at the tree and entering at the right edge.
A thin strip on the board expands into a skeleton-in-ground picture, as a projected-image wipe/fade in.
The skeleton picture grows to a larger size at burst, then settles back slightly smaller; ambiguous in 4 frames.
The skeleton picture squashes to a thin strip and then a skull image appears, a wipe transition.
A thin strip expands into a skull image on the board, a wipe/fade in.
The skull picture slightly changes in size and position across frames, settling into place.
